ports.name: Amakura
ports.rumour: The Halcyon Federation is rumored to possess captured Concord and Directorate research that it has not shared with either side. Several powers would go to war to seize or destroy it.

ports.name: Port Saffron
ports.rumour: A hidden, heavily guarded facility beneath the freeport. Rumored to be rebuilding or modifying something that should not exist in 1946.

pois.name: The Skarn Strait Wreck Fields
pois.text: Dozens of ships from both coalitions lie in the cold northern passages. Some still contain sealed technical archives and prototype weapons. The Halvards restrict access; everyone else tries to sneak in.

pois.name: Austral Barrier station
pois.text: Pre-war scientific outposts on the edge of the Howling Seas. Most are silent. A few still transmit on old frequencies.

pois.name: The Lost Squadron of the Central Hesperian
pois.text: In the final weeks of the war an entire Concord battle group vanished after reporting contact with an unknown force. No wreckage was ever confirmed. Both sides still search the area.

pois.name: The Throat Research Anchorage
pois.text: A heavily damaged Directorate research complex in the inner Sable Sea. Officially abandoned. Unofficially, signals still occasionally leave it.

pois.name: The Corvo Canal Zone
pois.text: Demilitarized on paper. In practice a nest of spies, smugglers, and deniable special forces. Whoever truly controls the Canal in the next war will control the movement of fleets between the Hesperian and the southern oceans.

pois.name: Austral Barrier station (east)
pois.text: Pre-war scientific outposts on the edge of the Howling Seas. Most are silent. A few still transmit on old frequencies.

POI_TEXT.wreck: Oil still weeps from the hulls of the Meridian War here. Divers can recover fittings, fire-control gear and papers, if nothing else is hunting the same scrap.
POI_TEXT.base: An abandoned wartime base: fuel bunkers, workshops, maybe a hulk left at her moorings. Someone may have got here first.
POI_TEXT.site: A research station that appears on no published chart. Whatever they worked on here is worth a great deal to the right buyer.

TECH.name: Fire-control radar
TECH.desc: +15% gun range and tighter shell spread.

TECH.name: Improved sonar
TECH.desc: Sonar ships detect submarines 60% farther away.

TECH.name: Acoustic homing torpedoes
TECH.desc: Unlocks homing torpedoes, which steer onto targets ahead of them.

TECH.name: Proximity-fuzed AA shells
TECH.desc: Anti-aircraft fire brings down 35% more aircraft.

TECH.name: Damage control schools
TECH.desc: Fires, flooding and breakdowns are fought 30% faster.

TECH.name: Amphibious warfare
TECH.desc: Unlocks Troop Transports and landing ships. Troops landed on a structure fight 25% better.

TECH.name: Jet aircraft
TECH.desc: Strike squadrons fly 70% faster and shrug off light flak. Unlocks the jet-age fleet carriers.

TECH.name: Guided missiles
TECH.desc: Unlocks anti-ship missiles, SAM launchers, the 76 mm gun and the Missile Destroyer.

TECH.name: Nuclear propulsion
TECH.desc: Unlocks the first nuclear submarines, which need no fuel.

TECH.name: Snorkel and fast hulls
TECH.desc: Submarines run 20% faster submerged. Unlocks the Era II diesel attack boats.

TECH.name: ASW helicopters
TECH.desc: Your sonar ships find submarines 40% farther away.

TECH.name: Electronic countermeasures
TECH.desc: One incoming anti-ship missile in four is decoyed away.

TECH.name: Close-in weapon system
TECH.desc: Unlocks radar-directed gatling mounts that shred incoming missiles.

TECH.name: Area air defence
TECH.desc: SAM range +40%. Unlocks the Missile Cruiser.

TECH.name: Vertical launch systems
TECH.desc: One more missile in every salvo. Unlocks the Era III missile destroyers.

TECH.name: Advanced naval reactors
TECH.desc: Unlocks the nuclear fleet carrier and the Era III nuclear submarines.

TECH.name: Tactical data links
TECH.desc: Salvos 15% tighter; anti-ship missiles reach 15% farther.

TECH.name: Nuclear warheads
TECH.desc: Your missile submarines can carry nuclear warheads, fitted at a port or naval base of your own or at the Enclaves. One destroys a land structure for good. The treaties that kept these weapons out of the world end with the first you fire: think before you do.

TECH.name: Cooperative engagement
TECH.desc: Every ship shares the squadron's fire-control picture: salvos are corrected a fifth faster, whoever spots them. Unlocks the Era IV fleet carrier.

TECH.name: Stealth shaping
TECH.desc: Your squadron is found a quarter later on the chart and enemy radar picks your ships up at three quarters of its range. Unlocks the Era IV stealth destroyers, corvette and attack submarine.

TECH.name: Long-range precision strike
TECH.desc: Anti-ship missiles reach 40% farther.

TECH.name: Electromagnetic guns
TECH.desc: A gun that throws a solid slug by electric power alone: very fast and flat, it holes armour at any range, but it carries no explosive, starts few fires and is slow to charge. Only a ship built with the power for it can mount one: the Era IV stealth destroyer.

TECH.name: Unmanned aircraft
TECH.desc: Every warship of destroyer size and more carries a drone to spot for her guns, which flies by night as well as by day.

STORY.title: Wolves at the Door
STORY.brief: Black Flag raiders are stalking Concord colliers off St. Aldric. Find the flotilla led by the destroyer Jackal and sink it.

STORY.title: Silent Hunters
STORY.brief: A Directorate submarine pack is sinking tankers on the Halbrook convoy route. Bring sonar ships (destroyers or corvettes). Submerged boats stay invisible until a sonar ship gets close.

STORY.title: The Codebook
STORY.brief: The Directorate destroyer Vigil carries a cipher machine and patrols the Wexmouth approaches. Sinking her gains nothing. Batter her until she strikes her colours, then take her as a prize.

STORY.title: Breaking the Strelsk Sounds
STORY.brief: A Directorate cruiser squadron under Admiral Orlov holds the Strelsk Sounds shut. Break it and the Vargan coast is open to Concord trade.

STORY.title: Iron Will
STORY.brief: The battleship Iron Will has sortied from Strelsk with her screen. Sink her and Directorate sea power is broken for a generation.

commission.label: Concord Commission
commission.blurb: An old Destroyer and a Corvette under Hesperian Concord colours, based at Calder Roads. The Admiralty has work for you. The Directorate keeps the armistice, barely.

smuggler.label: Freeport Runner
smuggler.blurb: A worn Freighter and a Torpedo Boat out of Port Saffron. Neutral with every flag, so every market is open to you, at least for now.

wolf.label: Lone Wolf
wolf.blurb: One war-surplus Submarine and a hand-picked crew at Halbrook. Strike unseen and slip away. The Concord pays well for Directorate tonnage.

gun: Guns reload 8% faster and shoot tighter per rank
helm: +6% speed and +10% turn rate per rank
dc: -7% hull damage and -15% crew losses per rank
ord: Torpedoes, missiles and aircraft rearm 12% faster per rank
